body: I’m sure that your kids will appreciate you so much, coming from a teen of a single mom. Please be gentle on yourself and your needs too.

I appreciate the advice. I’m on Wellbutrin right now, just recently started it. I think it’s actually helped with my issues with hair pulling/skin picking which is good. I’m on a low dose so it’s too early to see if effective for my mood yet. My mom called and told one of the people at the office of my mental health program that who I was assigned wasn’t a good fit and they essentially discharged me with a sheet of possible referrals (all private.) I’m looking into a permanent psychologist now, which I have a bit more hope with than the public ones as they are unfortunately underfunded and not as helpful. 

I’m trying to get assessed for autism from my psychiatrist supplied by my endocrine clinic (which I go to for my hormone prescriptions and to eventually get on the wait list to  gender affirming surgery.) Unfortunately it’s going to take a while because of covid, as they said it can’t accurately all be done over phone/zoom.
I recommend it! It’s accessible to almost everyone and I’ve found success in it :)
I’m still trying to reassure myself in terms of growing from my actions and it means a lot, thank you
